title: BRGC: Bounded Role-Aware Graph Context for relation prediction
description: Code and training-free analysis scripts accompanying the paper "How Much Graph Context Does Relation Prediction Need? A Controlled Study of Endpoint Statistics and Bounded Local Context". Contains the frozen model implementation used for every reported run and the parameter-free endpoint baselines, entropy diagnostics, and bootstrap confidence-interval scripts.
